texts.name: Nacron
texts.biography: Nacron grew up near a Hydra Pond, these creatures always fascinated him with their power, no wonder he made them his specialty when he became a beastmaster...

specialty.name: Hydras
specialty.description: Increases the speed of any Hydras, Chaos Hydras and Flying Hydras by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 7 levels (rounded up).
